title: Microsoft Teams: open, edit and discuss shared pages inside Teams
summary: Hold: the assurance that nothing happens until a user opens and edits a page is not supported by Microsoft's published description, which leaves arrival behaviour unstated. The roadmap facts and existing Loop control paths check out; conflicting Microsoft licensing guidance also needs to be acknowledged.
